content: 1. Regularly monitor your progress while taking this medication. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical appointments as directed by your healthcare provider. 2. Common side effects of this medication may include diarrhea, nausea, or heartburn. These effects are generally mild, but if they persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly. 3. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the potential benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. However, it is important to be aware that this drug may cause serious, potentially fatal liver disease. 4. Your doctor will order regular blood tests to monitor your liver function and detect any potential liver problems early. It is crucial to attend all laboratory appointments as scheduled. 5. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, if you experience symptoms such as rash, itching, swelling (especially of the face, tongue, or throat), severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing, seek immediate medical attention. 6. This document does not list all possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. 7. Before starting chenodiol, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other issues. 8. This medication must not be used during pregnancy, as it may harm an unborn baby. If you are of childbearing age, discuss reliable forms of birth control with your doctor, as estrogen-containing contraceptives may increase the risk of gallstones. 9. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before breastfeeding while on this medication. 10. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 11. Aluminum-containing antacids and certain cholesterol-lowering drugs (such as bile acid-binding resins like cholestyramine or colestipol) can reduce the absorption of this medication. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully to avoid such interactions. 12. To minimize the risk of side effects like diarrhea, your doctor will likely start you on a low dose of this medication and gradually increase it. Inform your doctor if you experience severe diarrhea. 13. Do not increase your dose or take this medication more frequently than prescribed without your doctor’s approval. Use this medication regularly to achieve the best results. 14. To help you remember, take this medication at the same times each day. It may take up to 24 months for gallstones to completely dissolve. Your doctor will monitor your progress with tests such as gallbladder sonograms or X-rays. 15. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. 16. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 17. If someone overdoses and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 18. While taking this medication, regular lab and medical tests (such as liver function and cholesterol tests) should be performed. Maintain all medical and lab appointments as directed. 19. Maintaining a normal weight and following a diet high in fiber (such as bran) and low in cholesterol and carbohydrates may help prevent gallstones. 20. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
